subject: Urgent: Solarin Labs service degradation — request for credits & remediation
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@solarinlabs.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@solarinlabs.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Repeated latency spikes & error-rate — request for credits

Hi Chloe,

We saw a significant regression in inference latency and a rise in server-side 5xx errors starting yesterday afternoon (May 23). Our production jobs are seeing average p95 latency jump from ~120ms to ~620ms and error rates from 0.3% to ~3.9% across several routes. This caused a number of downstream job failures for our users.

We reported this via status but need an urgent commercial answer — specifically:
- Immediate remediation ETA and any mitigation steps you can apply now
- Proposed credits for the impacted window (we consume ~2.4B tokens/month under committed capacity)
- Confirmation that our data and requests were not exposed or altered

Our CTO wants an exec-level discussion tomorrow. Please treat as priority.

Attached is a short sampling of metrics from our side.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
CFO, Solarin Labs

Attachment: svc_metrics_may2027.csv (CSV; 27 KB)
From: chloe.martin@redwood.ai
To: Maya Singh <maya@solarinlabs.com>
Cc: jordan.blake@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Repeated latency spikes & error-rate — request for credits

Hi Maya —

Thanks for flagging this and for the sample metrics. I'm very sorry for the disruption. I want to be transparent about next steps:

1) Immediate: we've activated a service-level mitigation policy (route pinning + short-term increased capacity). Ops is running a live rollback test now.
2) Investigation: Vivek (cc'd) is leading the root-cause analysis; we'll share a timeline within 4 hours.
3) Commercial: we'll propose a preliminary credit calculation after we confirm the affected windows and token counts.

Can you join an executive call tomorrow at 10:00am PT? If that works I'll invite our CTO and head of Customer Success — I want to ensure you have direct exec engagement.

I'll follow up with a quick note once we have the RCA start details.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Direct: +1 415-555-0199

Chloe / Vivek —

Quick internal note while I pull logs:
- Customer is on Dedicated pool (reserved GPUs) with commit. Verified subscription: 4x A100 equivalent.
- Preliminary look: we had a scheduler regression that allowed a small set of long-running jobs to monopolize batch capacity for ~2.5 hours (May 23 14:15–16:45 PT). That aligns with Solarin's spike window.
- Impact estimate (very rough): 12% of their tokens during that window served at degraded p95. We'll refine.

Commercial approach suggestion: offer a credit equal to 25% of invoiced amount for the impacted window as a starting point, with a write-up of mitigations and a commitment to a follow-up audit. Need leadership sign-off for anything >25%.

I'll attach the raw scheduler logs and a quick calc in the thread once I finish.

- Jordan

Cc: jordan.blake@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 16:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Repeated latency spikes & error-rate — request for credits

Hi Maya & Daniel —

Thank you again for patience while we investigated. Summary and proposed remediation: 

1) Root cause: an internal scheduler regression allowed a subset of long-running asynchronous jobs to bypass our time-slicing limits between 14:10–16:50 PT on May 23, causing elevated queueing and token-level spikes (confirmed by our logs).
2) Mitigations applied: rollback of the scheduler change, temporary increased allocation to your dedicated pool, and a hotfix deployed to enforce time-slicing.
3) Security: no evidence of data exposure or tampering — requests and responses are intact (audit logs attached).

Commercial proposal: preliminary credit of 20% for the invoiced usage attributable to the impacted window, plus a second technical audit (no charge) within 14 days and a written RCA. We've attached a draft credit calculation for transparency. If you prefer a higher credit, we will escalate to executive approvals.

Proposed next steps:
- Exec call (requested): Tue, May 25, 10:00am PT — please confirm attendees
- I will circulate a short RCA and the final credit calc within 24 hours after the call.

Attachments: proposed_credit_calc.xlsx (XLSX; 45 KB), audit_log_excerpt.txt (TXT; 12 KB)

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
